svg.aria-label: Agent sandbox products on two questions, CPU or GPU, and whether the sandbox forgets everything after each call or keeps its files. CPU and forgets: short jobs with a fresh sandbox every call, E2B and AWS AgentCore. CPU and keeps files: a computer per agent that sleeps between tasks, where most products live, Fly Sprites, Vercel Sandbox, Cursor, Coder, Together, and Daytona and Cloudflare, which share the host kernel. GPU and forgets: serverless GPU that wakes from a snapshot, Modal on gVisor. GPU and keeps files: rent a GPU VM such as RunPod, Lambda, Lightning AI or Fly GPU Machines, nothing built for agents yet.
svg.text: pick the shape first, then the vendor
rent a GPU VM, wire it up yourself
